recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed; any future changes to questionnaire calculated-expression behavior should be made in HL7/sdc or the extension-pack source.
issue_request: FHIR-19769 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire issue asking that valueExpression/value[x] in the questionnaire calculatedExpression extension be 1..1 when the extension is present.
initial_application: The Jira snapshot says the change was applied in commit 49bb304, but that short SHA is not reachable in this current checkout. Historical checked-in release output shows the migrated cqf-calculatedValue surface already had Extension.extension max 0 and, by the R4B history, Extension.value[x] min 1.
additional_context: Current core source keeps Questionnaire active but has no active calculatedExpression extension definition; source search found only the cqf-calculatedValue OID in source/oids.ini. The current questionnaire-specific SDC StructureDefinition has Extension.extension 0..0 and Extension.value[x] 1..1 of type Expression. The related FHIR Extension Pack cqf-calculatedValue definition is deprecated but also requires Extension.value[x] with type Expression.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source was edited. The required per-issue commit is an empty external-repo audit because the affected definition belongs to external SDC/extension-pack source and is already correct there.

related_jiras.note: Later SDC no-change issue about calculated-expression context of use confirms related behavior is now handled in the SDC specification, not FHIR core.
